title: 2026 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Nasser Al-Attiyah / Fabian Lurquin (The Dacia Sandriders) and Luciano Benavides (Red Bull KTM Factory Racing)
summary: The 2026 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its Saudi Arabia era: 8 stage towns and bivouacs through Saudi Arabia. Winners — Cars: Nasser Al-Attiyah / Fabian Lurquin (The Dacia Sandriders); Bikes: Luciano Benavides (Red Bull KTM Factory Racing); Stock: Rokas Baciuška / Oriol Vidal (Defender Rally); Challenger: Pau Navarro / Jan Rosa (BBR Motorsport); SSVs: Brock Heger / Max Eddy (Loeb Fraymedia Motorsport - Rzr Factory Racing).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
